definitions.explanation: The proportion of a population that has received a vaccine or inoculation. A key metric in public health for measuring the progress of vaccination campaigns.

examples.japanese: {接種率|せっしゅりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧きた。
examples.english: The vaccination rate has been rising.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧{接種率|せっしゅりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The influenza vaccination rate in this area is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{接種率|せっしゅりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{七十|ななじゅう}⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The government aims to raise the vaccination rate to seventy percent.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{接種|せっしゅ}→接種：22649_sesshu⟧ (vaccination; inoculation) and ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate; ratio). Became extremely common in everyday Japanese during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧{接種率|せっしゅりつ}: vaccine uptake rate
- {接種率|せっしゅりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: improvement of vaccination rate
- {接種率|せっしゅりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: vaccination rate is low
- {接種率|せっしゅりつ}⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: vaccination rate target
- {年代別|ねんだいべつ}{接種率|せっしゅりつ}: vaccination rate by age group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接種|せっしゅ}→接種：22649_sesshu⟧: vaccination; inoculation — the act of vaccinating, not the rate
- ⟦{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧: preventive vaccination — the full term for vaccination as a medical procedure
- ⟦{感染率|かんせんりつ}→感染率：30144_kansenritsu⟧: infection rate — measures spread of disease, the opposite concern
